ayahOccurrences.text: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: genitive masculine indefinite (form VII) active participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُّنقَعِرٍ is in the derivative form: مُنْقَعِر
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/ع/ر   q–ʿ–r bottom, depth, to excavate, to pierce, to uproot; to hollow; to knock down. Of this root, مُنْقَعِر munqaʿir occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُنْقَعِر munqaʿir [pass. part. of v. VIII اِنْقَعَرَ ʾinqaʿara] uprooted, severed at the root

(54:20) تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُنْقَعِرٍ it sweeps people away, as if they were uprooted palm stumps.
